description: Vaarweg - Walstroomlocatie in beheer van de Provincie Zuid-Holland is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Overzicht van de provinciale walstroomlocaties langs de provinciale vaarwegen. Walstroom is een voorziening die schepen voorziet van elektriciteit vanuit een walinstallatie, terwijl ze in de haven of op een ligplaats liggen. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are pleziervaart, provinciale-eigendommen, scheepvaart, vaarrecreatie, vaarroutes. It offers 6 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
